theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_lipschitz_sobolev
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (u : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K u → HasCompactSupport u → eLpNorm u ((n + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) / n) volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
